class.name: CgameDeterministicPhysics
class.brief_description: Small deterministic rigid-body solver for spheres and boxes with snapshot and restore.
class.description: [CgameDeterministicPhysics] is a self-contained rigid-body simulation built to be stepped inside a rollback netcode loop (see [CgamePhysicsRollback]). It supports spheres and boxes with friction, restitution, a sequential-impulse contact solver with accumulated impulses and Baumgarte position bias, SAT box-box collision with incident-face clipping, group sleeping, and ray casts. Determinism rules: the simulation runs in IEEE double precision with a fixed operation order, bodies are kept sorted by id, the broadphase sweep and the contact pairs are sorted with id tie-breaks, nothing iterates a hash map during a step, the solver runs a fixed number of iterations and contacts are rebuilt each step (no warm starting). [method snapshot] therefore serializes the complete simulation state, and identical inputs give identical bytes on the same build and platform. Bit-identical results between different compilers or CPU architectures are not guaranteed. A body with a mass of [code]0[/code] or less is static. A sphere uses [code]size.x[/code] as its radius; a box uses [code]size[/code] as its half extents. Contact normals point from the body with the lower id to the one with the higher id. Forces and impulses applied through [method apply_force] affect the next [method step] only and are not part of the snapshot. [codeblock] var world := CgameDeterministicPhysics.new() world.add_body(0, CgameDeterministicPhysics.SHAPE_BOX, 0.0, Vector3(0, -1, 0), Vector3(50, 1, 50)) world.add_body(1, CgameDeterministicPhysics.SHAPE_BOX, 1.0, Vector3(0, 3, 0), Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)) for i in 120: world.step(1.0 / 60.0) print(world.get_position(1), world.checksum()) [/codeblock]

method.name: add_body
method.description: Adds a body and returns [code]true[/code], or returns [code]false[/code] if a body with the same [param id] already exists. A [param mass] of [code]0[/code] or less makes the body static.

method.name: apply_force
method.description: Accumulates a force applied during the next [method step] only, and wakes the body. Ignored for static bodies.

method.name: apply_impulse
method.description: Applies a linear impulse immediately and wakes the body. Ignored for static bodies.

method.name: body_count
method.description: Returns the number of bodies.

method.name: body_ids
method.description: Returns the ids of all bodies in ascending order.

method.name: checksum
method.description: Returns a checksum of the current [method snapshot].

method.name: get_body_info
method.description: Returns the state of a body as a dictionary with the keys [code]id[/code], [code]shape[/code], [code]mass[/code], [code]size[/code], [code]friction[/code], [code]restitution[/code], [code]position[/code], [code]rotation[/code], [code]velocity[/code], [code]angular_velocity[/code], [code]asleep[/code] and [code]static[/code], or an empty dictionary if there is no such body.

method.name: get_position
method.description: Returns the position of a body, or [constant Vector3.ZERO] if there is no such body.

method.name: get_rotation
method.description: Returns the rotation of a body, or the identity if there is no such body.

method.name: get_velocity
method.description: Returns the linear velocity of a body, or [constant Vector3.ZERO] if there is no such body.

method.name: has_body
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a body with the given id exists.

method.name: is_asleep
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the body is sleeping. A group of touching bodies falls asleep together once all of them have been slow for half a second; touching an awake body or applying a force or impulse wakes a sleeper.

method.name: raycast
method.description: Casts a ray against all bodies and returns [code]{"hit": bool, "id": int, "t": float, "point": Vector3}[/code]. [param direction] does not need to be normalized; [code]t[/code] is the distance along the ray.

method.name: remove_body
method.description: Removes a body.

method.name: restore
method.description: Restores the world from a [method snapshot]. Returns [code]false[/code] and leaves the world unchanged if [param bytes] is malformed.

method.name: set_pose
method.description: Teleports a body to the given pose.

method.name: set_velocity
method.description: Sets the linear velocity of a body and wakes it. Ignored for static bodies.

method.name: sleeping_count
method.description: Returns the number of sleeping bodies.

method.name: snapshot
method.description: Serializes the complete simulation state to bytes (little-endian, bodies in id order).

method.name: step
method.description: Advances the simulation by [param dt] seconds: integrates forces, builds the sorted broadphase pairs, runs the narrowphase, solves contacts with a fixed number of iterations, integrates positions and updates sleeping.

members.member: The number of solver iterations per step. Must be identical on all peers.
The number of contact points generated by the last step.
The number of broadphase pairs of the last step.
The number of sleeping bodies after the last step.
The number of steps simulated so far (part of the snapshot).

constants.constant: A box; [code]size[/code] holds the half extents.
